activity.notes: Tariq ibn Ziyad, governor of Tangier under Musa ibn Nusayr, led the Umayyad invasion force that crossed into Iberia in 711, defeated the Visigothic king Roderic, and participated in the rapid conquest that followed. Turkish Diyanet's Islam Encyclopedia records that Tariq and Musa left al-Andalus for Damascus in 714. ATLAS therefore uses 711–714 as the representative military-activity interval under the Umayyad Caliphate rather than extending his Activity into his poorly documented later life.

sources.title: La batalla de Guadalete — Museo del Ejército de España
sources.citation_text: The Spanish Army Museum identifies Tariq ibn Ziyad as commander of the Umayyad forces at the decisive 711 Battle of Guadalete and summarizes the subsequent conquest campaigns.
